summary: Circumstantial evidence case; reliance on disclosure statements under Section 27 Evidence Act; co-accused prior discoveries invalidate appellant's recovery evidence; last-seen testimony insufficient; motive questioned due to abandonment of stolen tractor; rigor mortis timeline unexplained by prosecution; conviction based on unreliable discoveries and weak evidence; prosecution failed to establish distinct fact discovery by appellant; appeal allowed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellant acquitted.
